scope: Four further original clauses on printed Arabic page 70: iron ring, wolf-skin pronoun, animal pronoun, and well account. The source image was inspected at full size and with an enlarged diagnostic crop.
findings: The iron-ring clause prints six names but does not identify the weekday or clock hour behind its day and hour.
The wolf-skin and animal clauses use a pronoun rather than repeating a name list; no full referent is invented.
The well account names cloves (قرنفل), not carnation, and cites the final phrase of Quran 23:18. It is documented as a historical source claim.
preserved: Original name/card values and calculation core
Unknown vowels and unstated count/time remain unfilled by inference
limits: This pass does not constitute a full transcription of collective supplementary pages 75–90.
The first/fifth Tahatil spellings remain uncertain in the available image; an outside witness stays separately labelled.
Inaccessible external sources were not newly verified.
